name: PIGBLUE
source:
A stranger finds himself in a strange town. Both the man and the town have their shares of secrets. As the time passes, the man finds himself lost in the town and within himself. Help him out of the town...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个陌生人发现自己来到了一座奇怪的小镇。这个男人与这座小镇，各自藏着秘密。随着时间流逝，他发现自己既迷失在镇中，也迷失在内心。帮助他离开小镇吧……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400740/]Steam[/url]]
